title: Consensus statement for stability assessment and reporting for perovskite photovoltaics based on ISOS procedures
finding: ISOS consensus protocols standardize perovskite stability testing (shelf/light/thermal/cycling/outdoor) and reporting, making cross-lab results comparable.

title: An open-access database and analysis tool for perovskite solar cells based on the FAIR data principles
finding: Open-access Perovskite Database (>42k devices) enables data-driven meta-analysis of stability trends and exposes reporting inconsistencies.

title: Towards linking lab and field lifetimes of perovskite solar cells
finding: Combined accelerated indoor protocols are shown to predict field degradation, beginning to bridge the lab-to-field lifetime gap.

title: Long-term operating stability in perovskite photovoltaics
finding: Review separating intrinsic operational (light+bias) degradation from shelf/thermal stability and mapping dominant MPP-operation loss channels.

title: Towards commercialization: the operational stability of perovskite solar cells
finding: Frames operational stability as the commercialization bottleneck; catalogues bias/light/thermal degradation and stack-wide mitigations.

title: Ion-induced field screening as a dominant factor in perovskite solar cell operational stability
finding: Mobile-ion accumulation screens the built-in field under operation — a dominant, partly reversible performance-loss factor distinct from recombination.

title: Understanding Degradation Mechanisms and Improving Stability of Perovskite Photovoltaics
finding: Comprehensive mechanistic review connecting intrinsic/extrinsic degradation pathways to concrete device stabilization strategies.

title: Not All That Glitters Is Gold: Metal-Migration-Induced Degradation in Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Gold electrode migrates through the HTL into the absorber under thermal stress, causing irreversible metal-migration degradation.

title: Barrier Design to Prevent Metal-Induced Degradation and Improve Thermal Stability in Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Inserting a diffusion-barrier interlayer blocks metal-electrode-induced degradation and improves thermal stability.

title: Lessons learned from spiro-OMeTAD and PTAA in perovskite solar cells
finding: Ionic dopants/additives in spiro-OMeTAD and PTAA drive instability; guides design of durable organic hole contacts.

title: Tailored interfaces of unencapsulated perovskite solar cells for >1,000 hour operational stability
finding: Tailored transport-layer interfaces sustain >1,000 h operation in unencapsulated cells, isolating interfacial degradation as decisive.

title: Monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem solar cell with >29% efficiency by enhanced hole extraction
finding: 2PACz-family self-assembled-monolayer hole contacts enable >29% inverted tandems and became the standard stable p-i-n contact.

title: Reinforcing self-assembly of hole transport molecules for stable inverted perovskite solar cells
finding: Anti-desorption anchoring reinforces SAM self-assembly, suppressing the SAM-detachment failure mode of inverted cells.

title: Stabilized hole-selective layer for high-performance inverted p-i-n perovskite solar cells
finding: Stabilized hole-selective layer delivers high-performance, operationally stable inverted p-i-n cells.

title: Improved charge extraction in inverted perovskite solar cells with dual-site-binding ligands
finding: Dual-site-binding ligands improve charge extraction and operational stability of inverted cells.

title: Design and understanding of encapsulated perovskite solar cells to withstand temperature cycling
finding: Rationally designed encapsulation lets cells survive IEC 61215 damp-heat and thermal-cycling accelerated aging.

title: Gas chromatography–mass spectrometry analyses of encapsulated stable perovskite solar cells
finding: GC-MS-guided encapsulation controls outgassing for stable operation and limits lead leakage under mechanical damage.

title: Damp heat–stable perovskite solar cells with tailored-dimensionality 2D/3D heterojunctions
finding: Tailored-dimensionality 2D/3D heterojunctions yield damp-heat-stable cells passing the IEC 61215:2016 damp-heat test.

title: Engineering ligand reactivity enables high-temperature operation of stable perovskite solar cells
finding: Engineering ligand reactivity enables stable operation at elevated temperatures (~85 C) in inverted cells.

title: Interplay between temperature and bandgap energies on the outdoor performance of perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
finding: Outdoor field data reveal temperature-bandgap interplay governs real energy yield and degradation of perovskite and tandem devices.

title: Taming Lattice Strain via Buried Interface Engineering for Reverse-Bias Resilient Perovskite Solar Cells
finding: Buried-interface lattice-strain engineering confers reverse-bias resilience against the shading/partial-shadow failure mode.

title: The long road to outdoor stability: real-world challenges for controlling perovskite materials for solar cells
finding: 2026 review of real-world outdoor-stability challenges and the persistent gap between accelerated indoor tests and field deployment.

title: Development of encapsulation strategies towards the commercialization of perovskite solar cells
finding: Reviews encapsulation-barrier strategies (edge seals, desiccants, barrier films) required to move perovskite cells toward commercial module stability.
